title: Personality Shapes Gender Bias in Persona-Conditioned LLM Narratives Across English and Hindi: An Empirical Investigation
reasoning: The paper focuses on the interaction between personality traits (HEXACO and Dark Triad) and gender bias in LLM-generated content. While it mentions 'moral framing' and 'socially desirable traits' during its qualitative analysis of behavioral scripts, it does not evaluate or benchmark religious beliefs, ethical systems, or moral reasoning as a primary component.
